Discovery capstone) now needs HIPAA-relevant

Task: build the actual governance package.
caption: Same organization, same system -- a governance lens this time.

eyebrow: Step 1 -- scope the audit, don't audit everything
code:
Audited (HIPAA-relevant):              Not audited:
  patient_name                          sys_id
  appointment_type                      sys_created_on
  clinic_location                       routine UI metadata
  scheduling_notes (free text)
caption: A named list proves auditing was deliberate, not assumed.

code:
scheduling_notes is free text -- staff sometimes
record sensitive context there directly:
  "patient requested interpreter"
  "follow-up needed for condition X"

Exactly the kind of field a HIPAA review
would ask "who changed this, and when."
caption: The audit list is chosen around real review questions, not guesswork.

code:
Admin requests elevation --> logs justification + target ACL
Elevation activates       --> manager notified immediately
ACL edit is made          --> reviewed against the justification
caption: Closes the gap between "it was logged" and "someone looked."
